test: preserve held journal locks during physical byte observations

Read complete journal bytes through the original locked file handle and
restore its actual cursor after successful or failed reads. Retain both
real read-only append-failure injections and observe their original held
lock handles. Use a platform-absolute socket fixture and retain an absolute
sibling for the payload-conflict case. Production locks, path validation,
platform refusals, dependencies and qualification features are unchanged.

Preserve all41 original test entries, including the existing ignored
writer subprocess entry, and all177 original assertions. Add one real File
regression with9 assertions for physical mutation, cursor restoration,
read failure and exclusive ownership. Both independent source reviews
and exact source-preservation checks passed. Native Rust, Windows and
just fmt qualification remain NOT_RUN locally and pending required CI.
